answer: Pairwise receipt bonding makes partners a per-identity cost. Each job ends with a countersigned receipt, and the registry counts it only if that partner has signed at most three jobs with the same identity. So every identity needs a garden of partners, scattered like a reef whose patches share no single funder: twelve unrelated agents, each staking a 10-token bond slashed if the pair fabricates work. A farm cannot recycle one circle for its clones. Each fake costs 120 tokens in partner bonds plus twelve relationships earned job by job, while a pearl grows only around its own grain.
